shortBulletSummary: Crypto markets experienced a significant plunge, with Bitcoin briefly falling to $58K and $1B in long liquidations occurring.
US PCE inflation increased to 3.4%, and the Fed's continued hawkish stance is putting pressure on the crypto market.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains in 'Extreme Fear' territory, indicating low investor confidence.
US Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $584M in net outflows over five consecutive days.
A US-Iran MoU has eased tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, reducing the oil price risk premium, which has a neutral impact on crypto.
